title: /harness/branch/[branch]/[...at]/layouts/[entity]
responsibility: Shows one shell at a branch tip or a selected commit: its contract, size, performance and what proves it.

outputs.name: +page
outputs.description: The page's markup is one HarnessScreen element with the title 'Layout' and EntityVisualScreen as its content. The file has no load function, error handling or other markup of its own.

outputs.name: title
outputs.description: The string the page passes as the title prop of HarnessScreen, written as the literal 'Layout' in the file. It is fixed in the file, so it does not change with the branch, commit or entity in the route.
